decision: Preserve owner-approved explicit declaration. ExpandConfigFiles takes the package root through the existing firmware helper and uses it for the generated SHELL line and SystemRoot expansion. System32/command.com is absent under the actual host Windows root and present in O:/winnt/system32. Attach existing provenance to the changed call at original line 209; remove two redundant line directives. No binding change.
